text:
marta: FYI — AcmeCloud's PO (ref 98765) is stuck in the marketplace portal. Procurement sees a rejection with 'currency_mismatch' and portal logs show settlement_currency=USD but PO payload is EUR. Procurement has paused the order until this is resolved. @leo / @anya can you weigh in? :grimacing:

leo: copying finance. If the marketplace enforcer requires USD we can ask partner to reissue, but that adds 7–10 business days and breaks the committed launch window. Any chance platform can accept a currency mapping on our side?

anya: sales here — partner cannot reissue in USD; their AP team invoices in EUR only. They offered to sign an LOA for settlement exception if we can manually route payments. They need the PO accepted to kick off SIs and hardware provisioning.

jordan: ops checked portal logs. Relevant snippet:

```
ERROR 2026-03-21T15:02:11Z marketplace-api: validate_po: reject reason=currency_mismatch payload.currency=EUR ledger.expected_currency=USD vendor_alias=null
trace_id=tx-5f9b
```

Looks like our acceptance hook validates against the seller ledger currency and fails when they differ. Quick workaround: create a vendor alias with EUR settlement and attach to their partner entity. That requires approval from partner-ops/legal.

emily: partner-ops: creating vendor alias needs KYC + bank routing for EUR. I can fast-track KYC but need partner to provide IBAN + attestation doc. Also legal flagged that current MSA has USD settlement terms (section 4.2).

sam-bot: marketplace-support-ticket created: MST-14286. Severity=P2. Link: https://support.internal/mst/14286

leo: legal angle — we can accept an addendum to allow EUR settlement for this partner for the initial three months. @anya please get partner to sign the addendum. Finance will approve temporary EUR alias once legal confirms.

marta: Action items: (1) @anya get signed addendum from AcmeCloud today (they said they'll sign), (2) @emily open expedited vendor-alias path and request IBAN, (3) @jordan will flip a feature-flagged fallback to bypass strict currency check for MST-14286 once we have addendum + alias created, (4) @leo confirm accounting journal mapping for cross-currency settlement. If we can do these, we can accept PO in portal and avoid a manual invoice workaround.

anya: I'll ping partner legal now and post the signed PDF here when I have it. ETA 4 hours. :email:

jordan: dev notes for the fallback (for audit): set header `X-Settlement-Override: EUR` on acceptance call, record original currency in acceptance metadata, and force route to EUR vendor alias. I'll prepare a small patch and QE run.

leo: finance pre-approves the alias flow pending LOA. We'll need to post an internal memo for the accounting team.

marta: Great — circling back in 5 hours. If partner can't sign, fallback plan = manual vendor invoice processing (slower). Thanks team. :pray:
